10658.d: The Fishing Guild is a guild located in a fenced area north of East Ardougne and west of Hemenster.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The Fishing Guild is located south-west of Seers' Village and north of Ardougne, in the village of Hemenster. There are several transportation options:
• Use a skills necklace to teleport directly outside the Guild door.
• Teleport to the Ardougne lodestone and run north.
• Teleport to the Seers' Village lodestone and follow the road south-west past the Ranging Guild.
• Use the Lunar spell Fishing Guild Teleport, or get teleported by someone casting Tele-group Fishing Guild.
• Use a combat bracelet to teleport to the Ranging Guild and head west.
• Break a plain of mud sphere to be teleported to the Goblin Cave (the dungeon area just south-east of the guild), exit through the entrance, and head west. This requires completion of the Land of the Goblins quest, however.

gt.heading: Getting to the Fishing Trawler
gt.text:
The Fishing Trawler is located in Port Khazard. There are several ways to get there:
• Players on the Lunar spellbook can use Khazard Teleport to teleport directly to Port Khazard.
• Fairy ring code DJP is just north of Port Khazard.
• The charter ship has a stop in Port Khazard.
• All 4 types of the Ardougne cloak can teleport to the Ardougne Monastery, and Port Khazard is just a short run to the south.
• Completion of the easy Ardougne achievements offers free, unlimited teleports to the monastery on all spellbooks.
• The Watchtower Teleport spell or Yanille lodestone will get players to Yanille, from which they can run north-east to Port Khazard.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:

• Drakan's medallion teleport to the Barrows. Run southwest to Mort'ton, then north to Flamtaer.
• Fairy ring BKR to the Mort Myre Swamp, then run south past the Nature Grotto and down the winding path to Mort'ton.

gt.text:
Flesh-hatcher Mhekarnahz is located in a resource dungeon accessed via mysterious entrance in the eastern level 30 Wilderness, just west of the charming moths. 

Before entering the Wilderness, players should ensure that they are not opted into PvP. If the player has not done so, they must talk to Vala to opt out, preventing them from getting skulled and potentially being attacked by other opted-in PvP players.

The dungeon in which the boss is located is not considered a part of the Wilderness, and players will land on a raised ledge, which is safe from the boss. Once players have jumped down the ledge, the fight will begin.

There are multiple ways to get to the dungeon:
• Use the ring of kinship to teleport to Daemonheim, run southwest to the Fremmenik guard, talk to the guard to state that understanding the risk inherent of going into the Wilderness, run southwest past the shipwreck on the Daemonheim peninsula, run northwest to cross the isthmus, run past the waterfiends, green dragons, and charming moths until reaching the mysterious entrance.
• Teleport to Fort Forinthry lodestone and go through the north gate and head north past the waterfiends, green dragons, and charming moths until reaching the mysterious entrance.
• Teleport to Wilderness Crater lodestone (or level 18 Wilderness obelisk) and head north-east past the Graveyard of Shadows and the boneyard. Then head past the soulgazers, green dragons, and charming moths until reaching the mysterious entrance.

10765.d: The Flesh-hatcher Mhekarnahz resource dungeon is a resource dungeon located in the eastern Wilderness (level 30).

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
There are multiple ways to get the dungeon:
• Use the ring of kinship to teleport to Daemonheim, run south-west to the guard, talk to him to state that understanding the risk inherent of going into the Wilderness, run south-west past the shipwreck on the Daemonheim peninsula, run north-west to cross the isthmus, run past the waterfiends, green dragons, and charming moths until reaching the mysterious entrance.
• Teleport to Fort Forinthry lodestone and go through the north gate and head north past the waterfiends, green dragons, and charming moths until reaching the mysterious entrance.
• Teleport to Wilderness Crater lodestone (or level 18 Wilderness obelisk) and head north-east past the Graveyard of Shadows and the boneyard. Then head past the soulgazers, green dragons, and charming moths until reaching the mysterious entrance.

Players should talk to Vala to opt out of PvP, thus making the trip to the Flesh-hatcher Mhekarnahz a safe one, even though the dungeon entrance is in the middle of the Wilderness.
